name: Mazda Toyota Manufacturing USA - Huntsville AL

fieldNotes.truckGate: Massive JV assembly campus, fully perimeter-fenced (chain-link visible in 2026-04 Street View). Truck/dock operations are inside the secured perimeter; multiple controlled access points serve trucks. The truck gate structures are not directly viewable in Street View (coverage is limited to the public approach roads) so the gate-type call is inferred.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Main employee/visitor entrance off Greenbrier Pkwy is an open parking lot fronting the 'MAZDA TOYOTA' main building - no guard booth on that side. A guard/dispatch building could not be positively confirmed at the truck gates from overhead imagery. guardShack false / remoteGs true at medium confidence; both flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Inferred - gate present, no confirmed guard shack.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Large campus of 8+ distinct building masses - assembly, body, paint, stamping, plus utility and logistics buildings - spanning a very large site.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Two large dedicated trailer drop yards observed: one north-central yard with rows of 50+ trailers and a south staging yard; separate from active dock aprons.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Trailers backed in along multiple building faces; estimated 80+ total dock doors across the campus (50+ band).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Inbound parts/cross-dock receiving and finished-vehicle outbound run from physically separate dock and yard clusters on different building faces and different sides of the campus.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Campus has multiple distinct access roads off Greenbrier Pkwy - separate entry and exit points across the large property line.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide internal aprons and roadways and large undeveloped/graded paved areas leave ample room to add express/bypass lanes.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural - the plant sits on a greenfield megasite surrounded by farmland southwest of Huntsville; large open fields border the property.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur observed running into the property.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: Estimated 2 truck access points; the campus has several gated road junctions, exact count uncertain.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~504 acres for the fenced campus footprint.
